purpose: Determine whether locality-level diagnostics can distinguish capacity, opportunity, belief/choice, target-access, and execution bottlenecks that aggregate action-funnel counts cannot identify.
semantic_hypothesis: The raw failure labels believed_human_target_absent and believed_asset_target_absent occur after action selection and truth-side target enumeration, so they are target-access/execution-stage diagnostics rather than direct evidence that the actor held an absent-target belief.
acceptance_gate: raising only focal government-control belief strictly increases focal nonfielded-human-target choice probability
the same belief manipulation leaves an untreated control locality unchanged
high-belief target-present forced execution realizes a latent event
high-belief target-absent condition preserves the high planning weight but localizes to target_access
all eight seeds satisfy the stage-identification gates with stable source hashes
interpretation: A pass validates a locality-level diagnostic decomposition for synthetic identification. It does not identify which stage failed historically in Nepal or Afghanistan without locality-resolved historical evidence.
